action: Rank confirmation, containment and low-risk supportive actions above pathogen- or product-specific intervention.
Rank controlled cannabis evidence above cannabis observational/extension evidence, then hemp-specific evidence, then closely related greenhouse transfer, then generic transfer.
Never relabel preventative evidence as curative.
Require a current jurisdiction/crop/label/registration check before giving rates or approved-use claims.
Prefer active ingredient, organism or mode of action. Use brands only after current label verification.
Prefer actions safe across leading causes and defer actions that could worsen plausible alternatives.
Show transfer evidence only with an explicit transfer warning.
Surface applicability limits and lower confidence when context differs materially from the evidence source.
Capture requested diagnostic evidence before destructive action when practical.
Record better/same/worse and side effects; improvement alone never proves etiology.
